subject: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)

Team —

Effective immediately we need a temporary moratorium on new outbound sourcing for any new headcount requests. This is a 2-week pause to allow finance and product to rebalance open reqs against current priorities and to consolidate into skill pools where feasible.

Action items: 
- Pause all new outbound outreach for non-exempt roles. Exceptions handled by the exception flow below.
- Recruiters: move candidates currently in initial outreach to "On Hold - Sourcing" stage; continue to maintain notes and passive follow-ups but no active offers/closure without approval.
- Hiring managers: review your open reqs and indicate which can be merged into existing skill pools by EOD Friday (2027-04-02).

Attach: reqs_open_apr2027.xlsx, banding_rebalance_notes.pdf

Exception process (short): submit the exception-request form (linked in Confluence), get approval from your GM plus People Ops, and copy me. We'll aim for 48-hour turnaround on critical exceptions.

I'll run a sync Friday at 2pm PT to go over submissions.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Head of Platforms
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Bennett <sarah@beacontalent.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 9:10 AM Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Effective immediately we need a temporary moratorium...

Thanks Vivek — quick update from TA:
- Active outbound: 18 open reqs currently in outbound cadence (mostly cloud infra, mid-senior backend, and data infra).
- Offers in flight: 3 (two verbal offers pending confirmation; one signed offer awaiting start-date).
- Agency pipeline: Beacon Talent has 5 candidates currently in first screen.

Immediate plan from TA:
1) Hold all outbound sequences for non-exempt buckets now.
2) For offers in flight: recommend we allow the 3 offers in late-stage to proceed to close, but only after hiring manager confirmation. Need explicit approval if the offer includes any band exceptions.
3) I'll tag all affected candidates in candidate_tracker_q2.csv and move to "On Hold - Sourcing" stage.

Sarah: please pause outreach for roles RB-1103, RB-1110, RB-1119 until we confirm exceptions. Keep your notes on file — we may re-engage if an exception is approved.

Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah@beacontalent.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:05:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)

Marissa — thanks for the heads up. We will pause all outbound outreach for the listed roles immediately.

A couple of notes from our side:
- Candidates in-flight: Ryan Carter (RB-1110) had a strong loop and was expecting an offer call this week. He is receptive to a short delay but asked for clarity on timeline.
- Do you want us to keep running initial screens for evergreen pipelines (e.g., senior backend) or freeze everything?

We can also hold all candidate emails in our CRM and unpause quickly if any exception is approved.

—Sarah
Principal Recruiter, Beacon Talent

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)

Vivek / Soojin —

Quick question on exceptions: we have two roles (SRE lead, Data Infra eng) that are critical for a customer rollout next quarter. If leadership signs off, what is the fastest path to get an exception approved?

Proposal: 1) Hiring manager adds justification to the exception template, 2) My approval + People Ops review, 3) Exec endorsement (Vivek or delegated). Can we commit to a 48-hour SLA once ticket is submitted? If yes, TA can continue closing those two candidate processes without losing momentum.

Also — do we want to allow offers to go through if they require band stretch beyond current comp bands? That will need explicit sign-off from Finance.

Marcus Lin
Director, Engineering

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Bennett <sarah@beacontalent.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing moratorium + skill pool reallocation (temporary)

Thanks all — short update and practical next steps after sync with Finance and People Ops: 

1) Moratorium scope: full pause on new outbound sourcing and on new req postings for two weeks (2027-04-01 to 2027-04-14). Internal transfers and redeploys (skill pool consolidations) are allowed.

2) Offers in flight: TA may proceed to close offers that are already at verbal acceptance stage, provided hiring managers confirm and Finance signs off if band exceptions or sign-on bonuses are involved. Marissa, please flag any offer that deviates from band guidelines and attach banding_rebalance_notes.pdf when you submit for Finance review.

3) Exceptions: we will implement Marcus's proposed flow. Steps: (a) Hiring manager fills exception template on Confluence, (b) People Ops triage, (c) Exec approval (Vivek or delegate). We will target 48-hour turnaround for critical exceptions. Use the Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood/HR/exception-request-template.

4) Candidate handling: recruiters — move candidates to "On Hold - Sourcing" stage and retain outreach notes. For high-priority candidates (e.g., Ryan Carter), add a "do not ghost" note and a single courtesy update explaining the pause and expected timeline. Sarah, please update candidate Ryan with a short note and hold further scheduling until we confirm.

5) Headcount reallocation: Laura, I'll need your early draft of merged skill pools by EOD Friday so TA can map reqs. We will reconvene Friday 2pm PT to review. Link to current req workbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cRecruitingPlan

Attachments: reqs_open_apr2027.xlsx, banding_rebalance_notes.pdf

Thanks — lean on the exception flow where appropriate. We'll keep this narrow and timeboxed.

Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
